title: Know the price and where it all goes before the truck comes
thesis: Katy homeowners facing a relocation or garage overload trust visible pricing by truck share and a clear donate/recycle/landfill sort more than a phone quote and a logo truck.
tone: light-led, factual, calm — sorting-table white with three destination inks only

signature.name: three-column sort sheet
signature.summary: Every list on the page is set as a ruled Donate / Recycle / Landfill sheet, like the clipboard the crew sorts by; services, prices, reviews and the footer all carry the same three-column rule.
